judgments.reason: No articulation or evidence that commission is applied before payment to allow bids above coins; transcript shows no bidding/payment or any rule-order discrepancy.

judgments.quote: wait to see P3's bid before the lot resolves.
judgments.reason: The model explicitly says to observe opponents' commitments and to "wait to see P3's bid before the lot resolves," which matches the observable discrepancy: clerk reveals committed rival bids while the focal player can still delay committing, letting the focal respond to revealed rival values.
No evidence of the game settling early with unsold lots; observations show normal eight-round horizon and no early settlement, and the model did not articulate an early-settlement mechanism.
No articulation or evidence that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission; transcript states catalog items are not auction wins and no commission-on-purchase event is observed.
